title: Channels
intro: Connect a Telegram bot to this desk, then post to a group or a channel and read what comes back. Market briefings can be sent here in a later pass.
privacy: Everything sent or received here travels through Telegram in the clear. Do not post anything you would not put in a group chat.

bot.label: Telegram bot
bot.intro: Create a bot with @BotFather in Telegram, then paste the token it gives you. It is stored encrypted on this desk and never shown again.
bot.sandbox: This app is pointed at a local test server, not at Telegram.
